archive.verification: Archive headers and every regular/hard-linked payload checked against the manifest without extraction or execution

excluded_scope: Other preflight inventories or prior tracked evidence outside the selected directories

preservation.extraction_policy: The archive records modes and links; no claim is made that an arbitrary extractor, umask, filesystem or Git checkout enforces mode 0444. Verify bytes, modes and link relationships explicitly after restoration.

scope: Fixed snapshot of eleven completed independent review directories, retaining failed probes, subsequent reviews, logs, scripts and captured inputs; not a native input-lock approval
